posts.author: rookery
posts.body:

survival, no plugins except the basics, whitelist so we dont get griefed into the ground. its on copperline's builder plan so it should actually stay up this time. first server i ran was a hamachi thing called bracken, rip, it died when my laptop did.

post your mc name and ill add you. rules are on the signs at spawn, read them pls

threads.title: Chicago storage issue - some game servers affected

posts.author: Theo [Copperline]
posts.body:
Hi all,

One of our Chicago storage arrays had a problem overnight and a small number of game servers are affected.  If your world looks wrong, please open a ticket.  We're on it.

Cheers, T

posts.author: rookery
posts.body: mossfield is half gone. like chunks just missing. backup slot is the same broken copy

posts.author: Theo [Copperline]
posts.body:
No worries at all!  Your world will be back by tomorrow.  Iona's looking at it now.

Cheers, T

posts.author: rookery
posts.body: its not back by tomorrow theo

posts.author: i_bell
posts.body:
Update. The rolling backup overwrote the last good copy, so there is no clean save to roll back to. I'm rebuilding the damaged regions by replaying your LogBlock history onto the partial backup. Where the log has gaps the tool makes a best guess. I will mark guesses so you can check them.

Restore passes run in a maintenance window, 02:00-04:00 CDT. Please stay off the server during them.

posts.author: cairn
posts.body: guesses based on what

posts.author: i_bell
posts.body: Based on what you usually do. If you always place chests in pairs, it places pairs. It is a guess, not a memory.

posts.author: cairn
posts.body: don't guess my chests

posts.author: Theo [Copperline]
posts.body:
Small thing!  You can now type !status in game and the restore tool will tell you how it's going.  It's a little chat helper I bolted on.  Be nice to it, it's learning.

Cheers, T

june_shots.shows: June's first build on the new map: the little house on the point, tower base two blocks high, no top.
The old wooden dock east of her house, sunset. Dock and shoreline clearly visible (needed for Act 7).
cairn's sheep pen from the hill: six dyed sheep, four in the inner pen (Act 3 census backup).
Group shot at spawn around a cake. The three ORIGINAL rules signs are readable behind them, 'b4' visible.
Her tower, finished to the gallery, open top, no glass roof. Square full moon low in the NORTH sky.
Her tower with a glass roof half placed. Nobody near it. Blurry figure on the dock.
Same angle, roof nearly done, a glowstone lamp now in the top. The dock figure is gone.
Roof complete. Chat visible: 'it put a roof on it'.
The finished tower in daylight, glass roof, lamp. Her caption file: 'not mine'.
lowpath standing on June's dock at night. Moon is a waxing CRESCENT and rises in the EAST: impossible in Beta 1.5.

rules.title: who runs this mirror
rules.reply:
yeah. it's me. Theo. sorry.  I didn't know how to say it.  I didn't think anyone would actually come.

I kept the old box running after Copperline closed.  It's in my spare room.  It's just Mossfield.  It's just the residents.
rules.partial: Not sure what you mean, sorry!  It's just an archive.  I just keep the lights on.

rules.title: the 06:44 restart
rules.reply:
It was mid-replay.  Iona said if you stop it mid-session the region files corrupt.  Kit was asleep in the spare room and I just.  I didn't want him waking up to it gone.

I know.  I know what it sounds like.
rules.partial: That was a long time ago.  The panel logs aren't always right.
